title: Standard reports
reading_md:
## What it is

Standard reports are GA4's ready-made, aggregated reports.

- **User acquisition** groups users by their first-user channel, source or medium: how users were first acquired.
- **Traffic acquisition** groups by session-scoped dimensions: where each session came from.
- **Others:** Pages and screens, Landing page (the page each session started on), Events, Key events, Monetization, Tech, Demographics (subject to thresholds) and Realtime (the last 30 minutes).

You customise a report with comparisons, filters and secondary dimensions. Editors and Administrators change the left-hand navigation through the report Library. Dashboards arrived on 9 September 2026 (New in 2026).

**Channels.** The default channel group sorts traffic into 19 rule-based channels, such as Organic Search, Paid Search, Email and Referral. It cannot be edited. Announced on 13 May 2026, it includes **AI Assistant**: a visit referred by a recognised AI assistant, such as ChatGPT or Gemini, gets medium "ai-assistant" (New in 2026). Channel dimensions come in three scopes: First user default channel group (user), Session default channel group (session, paid and organic last click) and Default channel group (event, using the property's attribution model).

**Custom channel groups** are copies of the default group with your own rules, made in Admin > Data display > Channel groups (Editor role or above). A standard property can have 2 and a 360 property 5, on top of the predefined group. Setting one as the **primary channel group** makes it your default in reports.

**Tagging.** UTM parameters on your links fill the source, medium and campaign dimensions. GA4 reports `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_campaign`, `utm_term`, `utm_content` and `utm_source_platform`, but not `utm_creative_format` or `utm_marketing_tactic`. Google Ads auto-tagging adds a click ID (GCLID) and is the recommended method for Google Ads. When auto-tagging and UTMs are both present, the auto-tagged values win.

## What the exam asks

- Which report answers a business question. Decide user scope or session scope first.
- Which channel a visit lands in, and which channel dimension a question needs.
- How to change the channel labels that reports use.
- Why traffic shows as Unassigned, or with the wrong source and medium.

## Common confusions

- User acquisition is not Traffic acquisition: first acquisition against every session.
- Realtime is not DebugView. Realtime summarises all users; DebugView streams the events of devices in debug mode.
- The default channel group cannot be edited. Copy it into a custom group and set that as primary.
- Google AI Overviews and AI Mode count as Organic Search, not AI Assistant. AI visits that pass no referrer land in Direct (Unverified).
- UTMs do not override auto-tagging, and GA4 has no override option.
- UTM values are case sensitive, so `Email` and `email` become separate rows in source and medium reports. A medium that matches no channel rule lands in Unassigned.
- Unassigned is not "(other)". Unassigned means no rule matched; "(other)" groups rare rows because of cardinality limits.

## In Skillshop

Course "Google Analytics Certification (2026)", module "Manage GA Data and Learn to Read Reports": the acquisition, pages, landing page and Realtime reports, and customising reports (Unverified).
